study type: Prospective comparative clinical trial (randomized controlled trial)
exposure: Double-layer non-locking uterine closure with surgical refreshing of incision edges
cohort: Seventy women aged 18-50 years with a history of at least one prior cesarean delivery were randomized into two groups.
finding: Double-layer uterine closure with surgical edge refreshing resulted in significantly greater residual myometrial thickness, indicating improved cesarean scar healing, compared to single-layer closure.
followup_time: Six months (for primary outcome), six weeks (for secondary outcome)
